title: .mcp.json in a VALUES.md package, values.md standard version 0.1
description: The shape of the .mcp.json file a package folder may carry. Each server is either remote (it has url) or local (it has command), never both and never neither. The rules for a remote server apply only when url is present, and those for a local server only when command is present. headers is refused. Every other key, at the top level and inside a server, is ignored. Patterns are ECMA-262 regular expressions. Lengths are counted in Unicode code points.

mcpServers.description: One entry per server. Each key is the server's name: 1 to 64 letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

not.description: A server that needs a credential gets it from the host, not from a published package.

url.description: An address beginning https://. An http:// address is refused, loopback included.

command.description: A local server. A host starts it only with consent, shown with the full command.
